method: For artifact candidates whose canonical event is loop=yes, compare the last decoded sample to the first sample against the file's internal sample-to-sample delta distribution, compare first-vs-last one-second RMS level and spectral shape, and inspect stereo correlation for stereo beds. Metrics identify seam-review risk; they do not prove audibility.

criticalFindings.reason: The loop boundary is the largest sample transition in the entire file and is ~20.7 dB above the internal p99 delta. A click/step is plausible if looped without an intentional seam treatment.
criticalFindings.requiredReview: A/B listen across the exact Unity loop boundary. Re-derive/crossfade if the transition is audible; do not accept based only on overall ambience quality.

criticalFindings.reason: The boundary combines a rare sample jump with ~11 dB first/last level mismatch, creating a strong risk of a perceptible loop level step.
criticalFindings.requiredReview: Listen specifically through repeated loops at matched game gain; re-derive the seam if the level reset is perceptible.

stereoObservation.interpretation: The ocean beds are intentionally/strongly wide rather than anti-phase. This is not an automatic failure, but Quest playback plus any mono/fallback path should confirm that width does not collapse important surf information.

durationObservation: The audition candidates are materially shorter than the canonical full-production loop-duration targets in the PR #6 asset manifest (for example ocean ~50 s, rain light ~8.9 s, fire ~8.9 s versus longer planned production beds). Treat them as first-playable candidates, not proof that final production-duration requirements are satisfied.
rules: Loop seam metrics are technical triage, not human listening evidence.
A candidate remains candidate-headset-listen until the exact repeated boundary is reviewed in the intended playback path.
Do not hide an audible seam by increasing ambience level or masking it with another layer.
Any re-derived loop must receive a new output hash and repeat technical/listening QA.
PR #6 must still synchronize current main and refresh its payload pin before authoritative Unity/Quest evidence.
